Verified working — archived items stay out of your main lists, the counts are right, and restoring brings one back. The archiving prototype is at **http://maker:4001/archive.html**.

---

### 👉 Please try this flow

1. You start on the **All** tab showing your active bookmarks (6 of them). Pick any card — say *Kubernetes* — and click **🗄 Archive**. Notice it disappears from this list, and the **All** count drops.
2. Now click the **🗄 Archived** tab on the right. There's the bookmark you just put away, alongside others — kept, not deleted. A note at the top reminds you these are set aside but retrievable.
3. On any archived card, click **↩ Restore** — it returns to your active bookmarks. Switch back to **All** to see it there again.
4. While on the Archived tab, try the **search box** — you can still search within archived items to dig one out.

---

Two things I decided — please check them:
- **Where archived lives:** I made *Archived* a separate tab, deliberately set apart from All / To read / Finished, so your everyday lists stay uncluttered. Archived items don't appear in All, To read, or Finished.
- **Getting things back:** a single **Restore** button returns a bookmark to your active lists with its tags, note, and status intact.

**Does this way of putting bookmarks away — and pulling them back — match what you meant by archiving without deleting?**
